steps.what: Provide telephone support related to networking issues
Provide telephone support on connectivity issues

tasks.design: The specialist provides telephone support related to networking or connectivity issues. The call stays at full effort. {TELEPHONY} does not answer the caller. Nobody is scored.
tasks.previous_blocker: The specialist takes the call and works through the issue with the caller.
tasks.still_hard: Judging the issue on the call stays with the specialist.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist does not close an issue the caller has not described.
tasks.altitude: The telephone support stays the specialist's. Nothing in the call is shortened.

reach.task: Pass a caller who asked for the specialist
reach.learn: Which issues the caller could not describe.

evidence.claim: Telephone support on networking or connectivity stays a conversation.

assumptions: The work starts when a caller reaches the specialist and ends when the call is done, or the specialist stops.
No new record is required for the call. Upkeep is zero. The caller is not scored.
A later request record, if one is kept, is a different task.
unknowns: Which issues the specialist handles on the telephone rather than on site.
research_questions: Which calls did the specialist refuse to close because the issue was not described?

already_counted.description: Providing telephone support is already in the specialist's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the call adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every call is still taken by the specialist. High: the same telephone support remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Open stored performance measures for availability and speed
Evaluate local network performance to ensure sufficient availability
Evaluate wide network speed to identify network problems
Judge disaster recovery purposes from those measures

tasks.design: The specialist evaluates local area network or wide area network performance data to ensure sufficient availability or speed, to identify network problems, or for disaster recovery purposes. {DATA_PLATFORM} only opens stored measures. A blank speed stays blank. Opening them does not shorten the evaluation, which stays at full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: The specialist opened the measures and then judged availability, speed, and recovery.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored measures can be opened. The evaluation stays manual.
tasks.still_hard: Judging availability, problems, and disaster recovery stays with the specialist.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist does not treat a blank speed as sufficient.
tasks.altitude: The evaluation stays at full effort. The screen only opens the stored measures.

evidence.claim: Stored performance measures can be opened. Evaluating availability, speed, and recovery stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a network period and ends when the specialist has judged it, or stops.
A measure row has measure identifier, network name, availability, and speed, entered by the specialist from the test. A blank speed is left blank and is not treated as zero.
Opening the measures does not shorten the evaluation. The measures do not state the judgement.
unknowns: Which availability level this organisation calls sufficient.
research_questions: How often was speed blank, so the specialist went back to the test?

already_counted.description: Evaluating local network performance is already in the specialist's step.

incremental.description: Correct a network name on a measure the specialist has rechecked.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: speeds are often blank, so the evaluation is unchanged. High: the measures open, and the specialist still evaluates them. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Determine usage, space, and server function

steps.what: Total stored network usage and disk space availability
Total stored counters of server function
Analyze and determine what the network totals mean

tasks.design: The specialist analyzes network data to determine network usage, disk space availability, or server function. {DATA_PLATFORM} totals stored counters only. A blank counter stays blank and is not treated as zero. The specialist determines what the totals mean, at full effort. No model is called.
tasks.previous_blocker: The specialist added the counters by hand and then decided what they meant.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored counters can be totalled. Determining what they mean stays manual.
tasks.still_hard: Determining usage, space, and server function stays with the specialist.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist rejects a total that treats a blank counter as zero.
tasks.altitude: The totals are arithmetic. The determination stays at full effort.

evidence.claim: Stored counters can be totalled. Determining what network usage or server function means stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a period and ends when the specialist has determined what the totals mean, or stops.
A counter has counter identifier, network name, and value, already collected by the equipment. That collection is not the specialist's time. A blank value is left blank and is not treated as zero.
The totals do not state the determination.
unknowns: Which counters this report is expected to include.
research_questions: How often did a blank counter stop the total?

already_counted.description: Determining what the totals mean is already in the specialist's step.

incremental.description: Correct a counter identifier the specialist has rechecked.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: counters are often blank, so the specialist still builds the totals. High: counters are complete, the totals are shown, and the specialist still determines what they mean. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Perform routine maintenance on networking components
Perform standard repairs on networking equipment

tasks.design: The specialist performs routine maintenance or standard repairs to networking components or equipment. The work is on site and stays at full effort. Nothing in {OPS_SYSTEM} does the repair.
tasks.previous_blocker: The specialist maintains or repairs the component on site.
tasks.enabler_now: No remote step replaces the hands-on work.
tasks.still_hard: Doing the maintenance or the repair stays with the specialist.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist stops when the component is not the one on the order.
tasks.altitude: The maintenance and the repair stay at full effort.

reach.learn: Which components were the wrong item.

evidence.claim: Routine maintenance and standard repairs of networking equipment stay on site.

assumptions: The work starts with a component or a piece of equipment and ends when the specialist has maintained or repaired it, or stops.
No new record is required. Upkeep is zero.
A later note of the repair, if one is kept, is a different task.
unknowns: Which repairs the specialist does, and which go to a vendor.
research_questions: How often did the specialist stop because the component was the wrong item?

already_counted.description: Performing routine maintenance is already in the specialist's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the repair adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every repair is still done by the specialist. High: the same maintenance remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The specialist still decides access, diagnoses a fault, and signs a change. A permission list, report, or document is written or published only after the specialist accepts that version.
reach: An operations lead receives only a network report the specialist has accepted.
A service desk colleague receives only a request record the specialist has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a required counter, field, or resolution is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a write or a publication.
Keep diagnosis, access decisions, and physical work in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every monthly network report traces to a stored counter, and the specialist still signs the exception.
